tracks.title: Saturday Jar
tracks.genre: Hawaiian slack-key and steel-guitar ballad (island pop, 1970s Gabby Pahinui lineage)
tracks.subject: a honey seller at a Saturday farmers' table who writes a new line on the label of one jar for the same woman every week, and she buys only one jar, so he has shelves of unsent lines at home
tracks.caption: Hawaiian slack-key ballad, 1970s island sound. Slack-key guitar in open G tuning playing a thumb-bass pattern with soft hammer-ons, ukulele strumming gently on the offbeats, steel guitar sliding in long sustained notes, upright bass walking quietly, soft brushed percussion. Warm close room recording, light spring reverb on the steel guitar. Male tenor, smooth and open, clearly sung with gentle falsetto lifts. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 80 BPM, G major. Tender, hopeful, slow-sway mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no drum machine, no strings, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slack-key guitar and steel guitar]

[Verse 1]
Saturday morning I set out the jars
Clover, wildflower, dark amber
You come by before the church bell rings nine
You hold one jar to the light

[Pre-Chorus]
I write on the label in pencil
A new line every week

[Chorus]
Saturday jar, Saturday jar
One little sentence for you
You count out your coins and you walk to your car
And you never read what I wrote

[Verse 2]
Back in my kitchen there's a shelf full of lines
The ones you never have read
Sweet as the clover and slow off the spoon
I sealed them with wax and I wait

[Pre-Chorus]
This week on the label in pencil
Your name is the very last word

[Chorus]
Saturday jar, Saturday jar
One little sentence for you
You count out your coins and you stop by your car
And this time you turn it around

[Bridge - steel guitar alone]
You asked me my name
Now there's two cups of tea on the table

[Chorus]
Saturday jar, Saturday jar
Every line was for you
Take them all home to your kitchen, my dear
And I'll bring you a fresh one on Sunday

[Outro - slack-key guitar fades]

tracks.title: Six Weeks Behind
tracks.genre: psychedelic folk (Incredible String Band lineage, acoustic, droney)
tracks.subject: two pen pals since age eleven, one on Orkney and one in Tasmania, whose letters take six weeks each way so each answers a question the other asked in another season
tracks.caption: Psychedelic folk in the 1967 Incredible String Band tradition. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar in open tuning, hammered dulcimer ringing over a tanpura drone, wooden flute with a breathy tone, hand drums and finger cymbals keeping a loose lilting pulse. Warm room recording, light tape echo on the dulcimer, organic and slightly ragged. Male and female voices trading lines and joining in unison, clearly sung with a folk lilt. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, D dorian. Dreamy, playful, wistful mood. No electric guitar, no synthesizer, no drum kit, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dulcimer, drone and flute]

[Verse 1]
You sent me a question in the middle of June
I opened it when the first snow came down
You asked if the lambs had come early this year
I said yes, and they're sheep now

[Pre-Chorus]
Your winter is my summer
My morning is your night

[Chorus]
Six weeks behind, six weeks behind
Over the water, we talk
I answer you now what you asked me before
And you'll answer me back in the autumn

[Verse 2]
Your letter smelled faintly of eucalyptus
Mine smelled of peat smoke and rain
You said you'd been sick and you're better again
I wrote, get well soon, by the way

[Pre-Chorus]
We've been at it since eleven
Two grey heads on two thin pages

[Bridge - flute and drone alone]
If I ever stand on your shore
Will you know me by my handwriting

[Chorus]
Six weeks behind, six weeks behind
The ink is still wet on my thumb
I answer you now what you asked me before
And you'll answer me back in the autumn

[Outro - dulcimer and flute fade]

tracks.title: Dear Tommy, Love Me
tracks.genre: 1960s French yé-yé pop sung in English (Farfisa organ, jangling guitar, tambourine, girlish lead)
tracks.subject: a girl who ghostwrites her best friend's love notes to a boy, and the boy's replies keep describing details only she wrote, so she's the one falling for him
tracks.caption: 1960s yé-yé pop in the Paris teen-radio style, sung in English. Farfisa organ playing a bouncing staccato riff, clean jangling electric guitar strumming offbeat chords, a rounded bass guitar, light drums with a crisp backbeat, tambourine on every beat and handclaps in the bridge. Small-studio mono mix, bright and dry with light spring reverb. Female lead, bright and girlish with a playful lilt, two backing voices answering with ba-ba echoes, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, E major. Bouncy, giddy, comic mood. No synthesizer, no distorted guitar, no autotune, no hip-hop beat, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - organ, guitar and tambourine]

[Verse 1]
Dear Tommy, dear Tommy, I wrote it out neat
Janice can't spell and her handwriting's a mess
I put in the moon and the soda-shop door
Janice signs her name and I write him some more

[Pre-Chorus]
Then Tommy wrote back (oh, Tommy wrote back)
He mentioned my pencil, my pencil!

[Chorus]
Dear Tommy, love me, love me
You don't even know it's me
Janice signs the page, but I'm the girl
Who wrote you all that poetry

[Verse 2]
He says that he laughed at the line with the bus
I wrote it at lunchtime, not Janice, not us
He says that he blushed at the part by the gate
That's the one I wrote last, and it's late

[Pre-Chorus]
So Janice says, hey, write him more
Not knowing I'm done with the writing

[Chorus]
Dear Tommy, love me, love me
You don't even know it's me
Janice signs the page, but I'm the girl
Who wrote you all that poetry

[Bridge - handclaps and organ]
Tomorrow I'll sign it myself, myself
Tomorrow I'll sign it myself

[Chorus]
Dear Tommy, love me, love me
Now you're going to know it's me
No more Janice at the bottom of the page
Just my name, in my own pen

[Outro - organ, guitar and tambourine]

tracks.title: Mouthing It at the Back
tracks.genre: Scottish ceilidh folk-rock (accordion and fiddle with a full rock backline, Waterboys and Runrig lineage)
tracks.subject: a minister's speechwriter stands at the back of the hall mouthing every line, then the minister drops her best pun, and she mouths the rest into the silence
tracks.caption: Scottish ceilidh folk-rock, driving and brisk. Accordion playing bouncing chords on the offbeat, fiddle carrying a fast reel-like riff, strummed steel-string acoustic guitar, melodic bass, live drums with a steady backbeat, tin whistle doubling the hook on the choruses. Bright live-in-the-room mix, light plate reverb. Male lead, bright and slightly nasal, clearly sung, with group backing voices on the choruses. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 142 BPM, A major. Wry, brisk, affectionate mood. No synthesizer, no distorted guitars, no autotune, no drum machine, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fiddle, accordion and drums]

[Verse 1]
I wrote it on Tuesday, I fixed it on Wednesday
The minister's reading it now on the stage
I'm standing at the back by the fire-exit sign
Mouthing along to each page

[Pre-Chorus]
Here comes the pun, here comes the pun
Three lines, two lines, one

[Chorus]
And she skips it, she skips it
I mouth it at the back of the hall
Nobody's laughing, nobody knows
It was the best thing I wrote at all

[Verse 2]
The pigeon joke lands but the budget is long
She reads out the numbers too slowly
I'd cut that paragraph twice, I swear
She's lost her place, she's lost her place

[Pre-Chorus]
Here comes the end, here comes the end
She's looking up, she's looking up

[Chorus]
And she nails it, she nails it
The one that I thought would be cut
They're laughing, they're laughing
I'm grinning at the back, shut up

[Bridge - fiddle and accordion]
Nobody turns around to see me
That's the job, that's the job

[Chorus]
And she says it, she says it
In her voice, with my words on top
Nobody knows it, nobody knows
I mouth it at the back and I don't stop

[Outro - fiddle and accordion ring out]

tracks.title: Bees in the Sousaphone
tracks.genre: traditional New Orleans Dixieland jazz (collective improvisation, cornet, clarinet, trombone, banjo, tuba)
tracks.subject: a swarm of bees settles in the bell of the sousaphone the morning before the parade, and the beekeeper must be coaxed away from his honey stand to talk them out while the band keeps time
tracks.caption: Traditional New Orleans Dixieland jazz, 1920s parade-band style. Cornet leading the melody with a bright brassy tone, clarinet weaving fast runs above it, trombone sliding underneath with tailgate smears, strummed four-string banjo on every beat, sousaphone playing a bouncing two-beat bass, snare and bass drum in a marching shuffle. Dry live acoustic room, tight and lively. Male lead, gritty and warm, clearly sung, with band shouts answering. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, funny, danceable mood. No synthesizer, no electric guitar, no autotune, no drum machine, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - cornet, clarinet and banjo]

[Verse 1]
Tuba man calls me at half past seven
Says there's something in his horn
Put my ear to the bell and I heard a buzzing
Now the whole street's been warned

[Pre-Chorus]
Parade starts at noon
Bees got there at dawn

[Chorus]
Bees in the sousaphone, bees in the horn
Don't blow it, don't blow it, don't blow
I've got a smoker, a veil and a jar
Hold the beat and let me go slow

[Verse 2]
Drummer keeps the second line rolling
Soft on the snare, soft on the beat
Bees like a low note, they hum back to him
I tap the bell with my feet

[Pre-Chorus]
One by one they walk out
Down the brass like a queue

[Chorus]
Bees in the sousaphone, bees in the horn
Don't blow it, don't blow it, don't blow
I've got a smoker, a veil and a jar
Hold the beat and let me go slow

[Bridge - cornet and clarinet]
Honey for the band, honey for the band
Free jars at the corner by noon

[Chorus]
Bees in the jar now, tuba blows clean
Go on, go on, go on
Parade is rolling, the street's all swinging
And the honey is sweet in the sun

[Outro - full band]

tracks.title: Wajan Retak di Bulan Ini
tracks.genre: keroncong Tugu Portuguese-creole
tracks.subject: an old pandai besi in Kampung Tugu reforges the same widow's cracked frying pan every month, and slowly understands she cracks it on purpose to keep coming back to his forge
tracks.caption: Keroncong Tugu Portuguese-creole folk, unhurried waltz-leaning pulse. Bright strummed macina and ukulele cak-cuk rhythm, plucked acoustic guitar countermelody, bowed cello walking bass, soft wooden flute answering the voice. Dry wooden-room recording, tape warmth, light plate reverb. Female vocal, mid register, plain warm tone, conversational delivery with clear sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, G major. Teasing and tender mood. No drums, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no dangdut flourish, no pop gloss.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - macina strum, flute]

[Verse 1]
Bu Ratmi datang bawa wajan retak
Tangannya pegang gagang yang sudah goyang
Kutaruh di bara, kupukul pelan-pelan
Bunyinya nyaring seperti nada do

[Pre-Chorus]
Sudah dua belas kali bulan ini
Besi yang kuat kok bisa pecah lagi

[Chorus]
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, wajan retak lagi
Kutempa sambil pura-pura marah
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, kutunggu lagi
Besinya kuat, hatiku yang goyah

[Verse 2]
Dia duduk di bangku dekat tungku
Cerita soal cucu dan harga minyak
Kukira api yang bikin panas begini
Ternyata dia yang tak mau pulang

[Pre-Chorus]
Kuperiksa retaknya di bawah lampu
Rapi sekali, lurus seperti garis

[Chorus]
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, wajan retak lagi
Kutempa sambil tak lagi pura-pura
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, kutunggu lagi
Besinya kuat, hatiku yang luluh

[Bridge - guitar and cello alone]
Kali ini tak usah dipukul dulu
Duduk saja, kopinya masih hangat

[Chorus]
Wajan tak retak, Bu, wajan tak retak
Kali ini kupanggil kau tanpa alasan
Wajan tak retak, Bu, tapi datanglah
Besi dan aku sama-sama menunggu

[Outro - flute, macina fades]

tracks.title: Kursi Kesembilan
tracks.genre: Javanese gending pop with siter and kendang ciblon
tracks.subject: a travelling pasar-malam acrobat balances on a tower of nine chairs on her husband's shoulders, and he secretly recites the shopping list to stay steady, so she ends up with the whole list in her head
tracks.caption: Javanese gending pop, upbeat danceable kendang ciblon groove with a lively shuffle. Plucked siter running figures, saron and demung doubling the melody, bowed rebab ornaments between phrases, round fingerstyle bass guitar locking with the drum. Live gamelan-room warmth, tight and punchy mix. Female vocal, bright mid register, cheerful sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, A minor. Playful and cheeky mood. No electric guitar, no synths, no drum kit, no dangdut koplo breakdown, no autotune, no trap hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kendang ciblon, siter]

[Verse 1]
Aku di atas, sembilan kursi bertumpuk
Suamiku di bawah, bahunya yang jadi tanah
Penonton diam, lampu sorot menyala
Dia bisik pelan, aku kira doa

[Pre-Chorus]
Ternyata bukan, dia sedang menghitung
Tempe, minyak, dan sabun cuci

[Chorus]
Kursi kesembilan goyang, jangan goyang dulu
Beli telur setengah kilo, jangan lupa lagi
Kursi kesembilan goyang, tahan sebentar
Garam, kunyit, dan sabun cuci

[Verse 2]
Aku tahu daftarnya di luar kepala
Padahal aku yang paling tinggi di tenda
Anak kecil tepuk tangan tak tahu apa-apa
Dia sebut bawang sambil menahan napas

[Pre-Chorus]
Turun dengan salto, orang bersorak
Dia masih bilang, cabai seperempat

[Chorus]
Kursi kesembilan goyang, jangan goyang dulu
Beli telur satu kilo, aku sudah di atas
Kursi kesembilan goyang, tahan sebentar
Garam, kunyit, dan jangan lupa aku

[Bridge - kendang alone]
Besok pagi kita belanja berdua
Kau yang bawa kursi, aku yang bawa daftar

[Chorus]
Kursi kesembilan tegak, tak ada yang goyang
Telur, garam, kunyit sudah di tas
Kursi kesembilan tegak, turunkan aku
Pulang ke warung, bukan ke langit

[Outro - saron, siter fade]

tracks.title: Sandi Pukul Sembilan
tracks.genre: Minang rabab Pariaman ballad
tracks.subject: a wife in Pariaman and her husband working in Medan talk every night at nine on a ham radio rig, so the whole street listens, and they speak only in Minang proverbs so the neighbours cannot follow
tracks.caption: Minang rabab Pariaman ballad, slow rolling pulse with a gentle swing. Bowed rabab Pariaman carrying the vocal line with sliding ornaments, saluang flute answering in long breaths, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, soft frame drum on the off-beats. Small-room warmth, close natural reverb. Male vocal, mid-low register, steady sung melody with traditional ornament. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, D minor. Longing and warm mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no dangdut, no pop gloss.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rabab, saluang]

[Verse 1]
Pukul sembilan malam radio menyala
Dari Medan kupanggil namamu pelan
Tetangga duduk di teras, pasang telinga
Kita bicara pakai pepatah saja

[Pre-Chorus]
Air beriak tanda tak dalam
Begitu katamu, aku paham maksudnya

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, jangan terlambat
Suaramu patah-patah, tapi sampai juga
Sandi pukul sembilan, aku di sini
Pepatah kita rahasia sepasang

[Verse 2]
Kau cerita jemuran, hujan di Pariaman
Aku jawab, sekali layar terkembang
Pak Haji tertawa, tak ngerti artinya
Anak-anak tebak, siapa yang rindu

[Pre-Chorus]
Sinyalnya hilang, suaramu berdesis
Kuulang tiga kali, sampai kau jawab

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, jangan terlambat
Suaramu patah-patah, tapi sampai juga
Sandi pukul sembilan, kau di sana
Pepatah kita tak butuh terjemahan

[Bridge - rabab alone]
Hari Minggu nanti kutukar giliran
Biar kau yang dengar suaraku dari dekat

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, aku pulang
Tak perlu radio, cukup ketuk pintu
Sandi pukul sembilan, buka pintunya
Pepatah terakhir kubisik langsung

[Outro - saluang, rabab fade]

tracks.title: Sebelum Pukul Sepuluh
tracks.genre: Indonesian 1990s two-guitar band pop
tracks.subject: a wartel operator counts down to ten o'clock, when the night tariff starts, while a student in the booth waits with his girlfriend's number and coins, and she lets him wait until the very last minute
tracks.caption: Indonesian 1990s two-guitar band pop, driving mid-tempo upbeat pulse. Clean chorus-effect guitar arpeggios against a crunchy rhythm guitar, melodic fretted electric bass, tight acoustic drum kit with open snare backbeat, bright piano doubling the chorus. 1990s studio warmth, analog compression, glassy chorus guitar. Male vocal, clear mid tenor, earnest conversational delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, C major. Urgent, funny and sweet mood. No synth pads, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drop, no trap hats, no modern bright pop gloss.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean chorus guitar, piano]

[Verse 1]
Aku jaga wartel di ujung gang
Jam dinding bilang sembilan lewat lima puluh
Anak kuliah masuk bilik nomor dua
Pegang kertas kusut, nomor pacarnya

[Pre-Chorus]
Tarif malam mulai pukul sepuluh
Dia tahan jarinya, tak mau menekan

[Chorus]
Sebelum pukul sepuluh, jangan dulu
Koin tinggal tiga, napas sudah tertahan
Sebelum pukul sepuluh, tunggu aku
Satu menit lagi murah, katanya

[Verse 2]
Dia tanya, Bang, lima menit lagi, ya
Kujawab, Dik, jam tak bisa dibujuk
Jam sembilan lima lima, dia nekat
Salah pencet, ibunya yang menjawab

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia menyapa sopan, matanya melotot
Jam menunjuk sepuluh, dia tertawa

[Chorus]
Pukul sepuluh, tekan sekarang
Nada sambung, jantungnya ikut berdering
Pukul sepuluh, dia tersenyum
Suaranya turun, jadi lembut sekali

[Bridge - guitar alone]
Dia lupa koin, lupa bilik
Aku diam saja, kuhitung meteran

[Chorus]
Setelah pukul sepuluh, bicaralah
Tiga jam pun tak apa, murah saja
Setelah pukul sepuluh, aku tutup
Hanya bilik dua yang masih menyala

[Outro - piano, chorus guitar fade]

tracks.title: CQ、こちら石垣
tracks.genre: Yaeyama-style Ryukyu folk-pop with sanshin and sanba (kachashi-lilt, Yaeyama island duet feel)
tracks.subject: an Ishigaki man on his roof every night at ten calling CQ on his ham radio to a woman in Hokkaido, who answers with her snowy weather while he reports 28 degrees and cicadas, until she is the first to say they should meet
tracks.caption: Yaeyama-style Ryukyu folk-pop, island kachashi-lilt dance feel. Sanshin plucking a bright Ryukyu-scale riff with bare fingers and a nail pick, sanba castanets clicking on the offbeat, shimadaiko on the backbeat, round acoustic upright bass walking, shaker. Dry close room sound with light tape warmth. Male lead voice, mid register, warm and relaxed, a female backing voice answering on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, C major. Warm, playful, long-distance romance. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar distortion, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sanshin riff, sanba clicks]

[Verse 1]
屋根の上で アンテナを回す
夜の十時 いつもの時間
シーキュー シーキュー 呼びかけると
ざざっと鳴って 君の声

[Pre-Chorus]
そっちは雪で こっちは二十八度
天気の話だけで ふたり笑う

[Chorus]
こちら石垣 聞こえますか
北の海を 越えて届け
知ってるのは コールサインだけ
それでもいい 毎晩待ってる

[Verse 2]
君の町は 窓が凍ると言う
ぼくの町は 夜も蝉が鳴く
ノイズの中の 小さな笑い声
ダイヤルを そっと回す

[Pre-Chorus]
そっちは吹雪で こっちは星空
雑音までが 愛しくなる

[Chorus]
こちら石垣 聞こえますか
北の海を 越えて届け
名前はまだ 知らないけれど
声で分かる 毎晩君だ

[Bridge]
会ってみようか 言いかけて
電波がぷつんと 切れた夜
次の日 先に言ったのは君

[Chorus]
こちら石垣 聞こえますか
会いに行くよ 北の町へ
コールサインの紙を 胸に入れて

[Outro - sanshin riff fades]

tracks.title: ひまわり食堂の黄色
tracks.genre: Showa-era orchestral kayokyoku (1960s grand-orchestra TV-show ballad, strings and harp)
tracks.subject: a hand-lettering signboard painter who repaints the faded yellow sunflower on a widow's diner sign every April for twelve years, still coming this year when the paint has not faded, and she says come again next year
tracks.caption: Showa-era orchestral kayokyoku, 1960s grand-orchestra TV-show ballad. Lush string section playing long legato lines, harp arpeggios, French horn countermelody, upright piano on the chords, brushed snare, vibraphone in the bridge. Warm analogue 1960s studio hall reverb. Female lead, warm alto, light vibrato. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, F major. Tender, patient, quietly romantic. No electronic drums, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - harp arpeggio, strings enter]

[Verse 1]
春になると 刷毛を持って
ひまわりの黄色を 塗り直す
日に焼けた 食堂の看板
あなたは湯気の向こうで見てる

[Pre-Chorus]
十二年 同じ文字を
なぞるたびに 少し近づく

[Chorus]
ひまわり食堂 色褪せないで
あなたの笑顔も 看板も
まだ乾かない 黄色の上に
言えない言葉を 重ねてる

[Verse 2]
今年の黄色は まだ褪せてない
それでもぼくは 刷毛を持つ
あなたはお茶を ふたつ置いて
「どうぞ」とだけ 言ってくれた

[Pre-Chorus]
看板屋さん 筆の先が
いつもより ゆっくりね

[Chorus]
ひまわり食堂 色褪せないで
あなたの声も 湯気の中
まだ乾かない 黄色の上に
言えない言葉を 重ねてる

[Bridge - vibraphone, strings swell]
来年も 来てくださいね
その一言で 手が止まった

[Chorus]
ひまわり食堂 ずっと同じ
黄色の下で 待っている
乾いた看板 見上げたら
小さな花が 描き足してあった

[Outro - harp and strings, slow close]

tracks.title: ぼくのカエルは帽子になった
tracks.genre: 1980s Japanese electro-funk boogie (Tokyo studio-session boogie, slap bass and Linn-style drum machine)
tracks.subject: a 38-year-old father at a Sunday community-centre origami class whose teacher is a seven-year-old champion named Mio, and whose paper frog keeps turning out as a hat
tracks.caption: 1980s Japanese electro-funk boogie, Tokyo studio-session style. Slap bass playing a busy syncopated line, Linn-style drum machine with a tight clap on the two and four, Rhodes electric piano comping, clean funk rhythm guitar with sixteenth-note scratches, short synth brass stabs, handclaps. Glossy dry 1983 studio sound. Male lead, bright mid register, comic storytelling, group backing shouts on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, E minor. Funny, upbeat, good-natured. No rap, no autotune, no distorted guitar, no modern trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass, drum machine, brass stabs]

[Verse 1]
日曜の公民館 折り紙教室
先生は七つの ミオちゃん
ぼくは三十八 額に汗
角と角を 合わせるだけなのに

[Pre-Chorus]
おじさん それは逆だよ
もう一回 やってみて

[Chorus]
カエルを折ったら 帽子になった
ぴょんとも跳ばない 帽子
ミオちゃんは言う 味があるね
ぼくの負けだ 完敗だ

[Verse 2]
隣のおばあちゃんは 鶴を三羽
ぼくの紙は もうぐしゃぐしゃ
手の汗で 折り目がにじんでる
ミオちゃんが そっと紙を替える

[Pre-Chorus]
おじさん それは船だよ
カエルじゃないよ 船だよ

[Chorus]
カエルを折ったら 船になった
水に浮かべば 勝てるかも
ミオちゃんは言う 来週もね
ぼくは来る 絶対来る

[Bridge - handclaps, bass break]
帰りの玄関で 振り返ると
ミオちゃんが 帽子をかぶってた

[Chorus]
カエルを折ったら 帽子になった
みんなで笑って 拍手した
ミオちゃんは言う 合格だよ
ぼくのカエルは 帽子のまま

[Outro - brass stabs, drum machine tag]

tracks.title: 七番席のお客さん
tracks.genre: Japanese Taisho-roman dark cabaret ballad (accordion, felt piano and clarinet, silent-film hall atmosphere)
tracks.subject: a young woman benshi narrating a silent film in an Asakusa-style hall to the one customer in seat seven, an old man who never watches the screen, only her mouth, so she slows every line to his reading speed
tracks.caption: Japanese Taisho-roman dark cabaret ballad, silent-film hall atmosphere. Accordion holding slow swaying chords, felt-muted upright piano, clarinet answering the vocal line in the low register, bowed double bass, brushed snare. Dim warm room reverb like an old picture hall. Female lead, low alto, slow deliberate phrasing, every word shaped clearly. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D minor. Wistful, hushed, dark-romantic. No electronic drums, no synth pads, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no big pop chorus lift.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and felt piano]

[Verse 1]
銀幕に 雨のような傷が走る
弁士の私は 七番席を見る
お客はいつも ひとりだけ
画面でなく 私の口を見てる

[Pre-Chorus]
音のない世界の目が
言葉のかたちを 拾っていく

[Chorus]
ゆっくり話そう 七番席の人
あなたに読める 速さで
唇のかたちを ひとつずつ
愛の台詞を 手渡すように

[Verse 2]
筋書きは 毎週変わるけれど
あなたの席は 変わらない
聞こえないことを 一度も
あなたは 私に言わなかった

[Pre-Chorus]
活動写真の 最後の幕
灯りがつくと 目が合った

[Chorus]
ゆっくり話そう 七番席の人
閉館の貼り紙 剥がすまで
ふりがなのように 唇を結ぶ
愛の台詞を 私の言葉で

[Bridge - clarinet alone, accordion enters]
銀幕の恋が 終わるころ
あなたの指が 小さく拍手した

[Chorus]
ゆっくり話そう 七番席の人
画面が消えても ここにいる
あなたにだけ 読める速さで
愛していますと 言ってみる

[Outro - felt piano, clarinet fades]

tracks.title: チラシの端っこ
tracks.genre: Japanese busking-duo folk-pop (harmonica, twelve-string guitar and cajon, 2000s street-duo feel)
tracks.subject: a woman who finds a hand-written note in the margin of the same pizza-shop flyer in her mailbox every Thursday, never orders, and one week finally writes back in the margin with her order
tracks.caption: Japanese busking-duo folk-pop, 2000s street-duo feel. Twelve-string acoustic guitar strummed in bright open chords, harmonica fills between phrases, cajon on the backbeat, nylon-string guitar picking a countermelody, tambourine. Live-in-one-room acoustic sound, open and bright. Male and female duo, unison verses and two-part harmony on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, G major. Bright, cheeky, sweetly romantic. No electronic drums, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no distorted guitar, no string orchestra.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twelve-string strum, harmonica]

[Verse 1]
ポストを開けたら チラシが三枚
ピザ屋のだけ 端に字がある
今日は寒いね 風邪ひかないで
ボールペンの 丸い文字

[Pre-Chorus]
注文したことなんて 一度もないのに
毎週木曜 わたしを待ってる

[Chorus]
チラシの端っこ 返事を書いた
マルゲリータ 一枚お願い
届いた箱に 小さなメモ
やっと呼んでくれたね

[Verse 2]
次の木曜 また端っこに
今日は何が 好きですか
わたしは 迷って 鉛筆で
ハートの隣に チーズと書く

[Pre-Chorus]
配達の顔も 知らないのに
階段の音で 分かる気がする

[Chorus]
チラシの端っこ 返事を書いた
今度は二枚 お願い
玄関のベルが 鳴ったとき
わたしの手が 少し震えた

[Bridge - harmonica solo, cajon only]
ドアを開けたら 丸い字の人が
照れて笑って 箱を差し出した

[Chorus]
チラシの端っこ 始まりだった
来週も ここに書くよ
箱の下には 小さなメモ
次は一緒に 食べませんか

[Outro - strum and harmonica, quick stop]

tracks.title: 인형이 대신 말해요
tracks.genre: Korean 1980s Italo-disco Hi-NRG dance pop
tracks.subject: a ventriloquist at a Daegu shopping-street stage who is too shy to speak to the bakery woman, so his wooden dummy blurts out his feelings and he has to pretend it is not him
tracks.caption: Korean 1980s Italo-disco Hi-NRG dance pop. Driving octave synth bass, tight drum machine with four-on-the-floor kick and open hi-hat, bright electric piano stabs, clean chorus-effect rhythm guitar, short analog synth lead answering the vocal. Glossy 1980s Euro dance-floor mix. Male baritone, bright playful cheeky delivery, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 126 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, danceable, sweet. No rap, no autotune, no EDM drops, no trap hi-hats, no brass section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - octave synth bass and electric piano stab]

[Verse 1]
저는 복화술사 봉 씨예요
무대에선 입술이 안 움직여요
빵집 누나가 객석에 앉으면
이상하게 제 입이 굳어요

[Pre-Chorus]
그때 나무 인형이 고개를 들어
큰 소리로 말해 버려요

[Chorus]
인형이 대신 말해요 좋아한대요
저 아니고요 얘가 그랬어요
뚝딱뚝딱 턱이 열리고
제 얼굴은 빨개져요

[Verse 2]
어제는 크림빵 두 개를 샀어요
인형이 속삭여요 오늘도 예쁘대
누나가 웃으며 거스름돈을 줘요
저는 천장만 보고 있어요

[Chorus]
인형이 대신 말해요 보고 싶대요
저 아니고요 얘가 그랬어요
뚝딱뚝딱 턱이 열리고
제 가슴은 쿵쿵 뛰어요

[Bridge - synth lead breaks, bass climbs]
누나가 인형 손을 잡았어요
그럼 그쪽은 어때요 하고 물어요
제 입술이 처음으로 움직여요

[Chorus]
이번엔 제가 말해요 좋아해요
인형 말고요 제가 그랬어요
뚝딱뚝딱 턱은 닫히고
누나는 크게 웃어요

[Outro - synth bass, drum machine fade]
뚝딱 뚝딱 뚝딱

tracks.title: 활터의 빈 과녁
tracks.genre: 1970s Korean Sanullim-style folk-rock with harmonium and flute
tracks.subject: a woman in her first year at a traditional Korean archery range (gungdo) whose arrows keep landing in the sand in front of the target, until the old range master tells her to stop aiming and breathe out like a sigh
tracks.caption: 1970s Korean folk-rock in the Sanullim vein, pastoral and unhurried. 12-string acoustic guitar strum, fuzzy electric guitar answering in short lines, wheezy harmonium pad, wooden flute melody, brushed drums with a soft kick. Warm analog tape saturation, light spring reverb. Male tenor, warm slightly nasal vintage tone, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D major. Wistful, gentle, pastoral. No rap, no autotune, no synth pads, no electronic drums, no modern polish.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 12-string guitar and wooden flute]

[Verse 1]
새벽 활터에 안개가 깔려요
저는 올해 처음 활을 잡았어요
쏘는 화살마다 모래에 꽂혀요
과녁은 멀리서 말이 없어요

[Chorus]
숨을 내쉬어요 한숨처럼요
겨눌수록 화살이 가라앉아요
손을 놓아요 바람에 맡겨요
빈 과녁이 나를 기다려요

[Verse 2]
사범님은 찻잔만 들고 계세요
힘 빼라 힘 빼라 그 말만 하세요
어깨에 얹힌 어제의 일들을
활시위에 걸어 놓지 말래요

[Chorus]
숨을 내쉬어요 한숨처럼요
겨눌수록 화살이 가라앉아요
손을 놓아요 바람에 맡겨요
빈 과녁이 나를 기다려요

[Bridge - harmonium alone, flute answers]
사범님이 웃으며 말해요
못 맞혀도 괜찮다고요

[Verse 3]
마지막 한 대를 천천히 들어요
숨이 나가고 손이 열렸어요
딱 하는 소리가 안개를 갈라요
과녁 가장자리에 박혔어요

[Chorus]
숨을 내쉬어요 한숨처럼요
놓았더니 화살이 가닿았어요
손을 놓아요 바람에 맡겨요
빈 과녁이 웃어 줘요

[Outro - 12-string guitar, flute fades]

tracks.title: 눈 내리는 유리 속
tracks.genre: Korean indie-folk with accordion, stomp-clap and mandolin
tracks.subject: a woman who repairs snow globes in a tiny Euljiro shop, and a quiet man who keeps bringing back the same Namsan Tower globe for a leak that she realizes he is making himself so he can see her
tracks.caption: Korean indie-folk with a stomping, clapping groove. Breathy-bellows accordion carrying the melody, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, bright mandolin tremolo, upright bass walking in two, foot stomp and hand claps on the backbeat. Close room recording, warm wood tone, light tape hiss. Female alto, soft husky tone, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, G major. Tender, warm, a little bashful. No rap, no autotune, no electronic beats, no synth pads, no heavy reverb.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and mandolin, foot stomp]

[Verse 1]
을지로 골목 작은 가게에서
저는 스노우볼을 고쳐요
유리 안에 남산타워가 서 있고
눈가루가 천천히 가라앉아요

[Pre-Chorus]
한 남자가 문을 밀고 들어와요
조용히 유리공을 내밀어요

[Chorus]
또 새어요 물이 줄었어요
죄송해요 하고 고개를 숙여요
저는 새 물을 가득 채워 줘요
이번 주도 그가 다시 와요

[Verse 2]
고무 패킹은 멀쩡히 붙어 있어요
뚜껑에 작은 바늘 자국이 있어요
제가 아무 말 안 하고 웃으면
그는 귀 끝까지 빨개져요

[Pre-Chorus]
다음 주에도 새게 될까요
저는 차를 두 잔 끓여요

[Chorus]
또 새어요 물이 줄었어요
이번엔 제가 먼저 말해요
이 유리공은 이제 괜찮아요
대신 차는 식기 전에 마셔요

[Bridge - accordion alone, clap on the backbeat]
눈이 내려요 유리 속에서요
가게 안에서도 내려요

[Chorus]
안 새어요 물은 그대로예요
그가 처음으로 큰 소리로 웃어요
저는 문 앞 팻말을 돌려놓아요
오늘은 둘이 눈을 봐요

[Outro - accordion and mandolin, stomp slows]

[Intro - fingerpicked guitar, uilleann pipes enter]

[Verse 1]
지리산 산장에 등불을 켜요
해마다 같은 날 그가 오고
방명록 한 줄을 남기고 가요
저는 그 글씨를 기다려요

바람이 문틈으로 지나가요

돌아왔어요 한 줄이 적혀 있어요

[Outro - guitar and fiddle settle]

tracks.title: Manik Skor Ke Tujuh
tracks.genre: 1960s Malay folk-rock (12-string jangle, Byrds-lineage)
tracks.subject: a girl who keeps score on the bead rack at a Seremban snooker hall and slides one bead too many for the quiet boy at table four
tracks.caption: 1960s Malay folk-rock, jangling sub-style with Byrds-like stacked harmonies. Bright 12-string electric guitar strumming open chords, warm round-tone bass guitar, light snare-and-tambourine drum kit, upright piano tapping offbeats. Analog tape warmth, slight room reverb, band recorded live. Male tenor lead with a female harmony line above, mid register, plain melodic delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Bashful, warm, light-footed mood. No electronic drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no heavy distortion, no trap hi-hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 12-string guitar jangle, tambourine]

[Verse 1]
Dewan biliard di Seremban, kipas berpusing
Dia datang pukul tujuh, duduk meja empat
Akulah budak skor, jari atas manik
Setiap kali dia menang, aku senyum sorok

[Pre-Chorus]
Manik kayu bunyi tak tak tak
Hati aku pun ikut berdetak

[Chorus]
Skor ke tujuh, tolak satu lagi
Dia tak perasan, aku tolak sendiri
Kapur biru di jari, mata di belakang
Ya Tuhan, janganlah dia pandang

[Verse 2]
Dia main perlahan, tak pernah marah
Bila kalah dia gelak, belanja aku teh ais
Aku kira mata dia, bukan mata bola
Salah tolak lagi, tauke jeling dari kaunter

[Pre-Chorus]
Manik kayu bunyi tak tak tak
Dia tanya, kenapa skor aku banyak

[Chorus]
Skor ke tujuh, tambah satu lagi
Dia dah perasan, dia senyum sendiri
Kapur biru di jari, mata bertentang
Malam ini dia pandang, aku pandang

[Bridge - guitar and harmony only]
Meja empat kosong, esok dia datang
Aku susun manik, aku tunggu dia

[Outro - 12-string jangle fades]
Tak tak tak, tak tak tak
Skor ke tujuh, kita mula balik

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gambus ostinato, marwas drums]

[Verse 1]
Pukul dua pagi, isteri mengidam
Jeruk kedondong, kata dia, sekarang
Aku capai kunci, kedai semua tutup
Di Muar yang sunyi, aku mula berdoa

[Pre-Chorus]
Ketuk pintu rumah Mak Cik Siti
Dia bangun, dia tak marah pun

[Chorus]
Jeruk kedondong, masam manis garam
Mak Cik kacau balang, aku pegang lampu
Jeruk kedondong, belum masak lagi
Tunggulah dulu, Abang, duduk dulu

[Verse 2]
Mak Cik kata, jeruk perlu tiga hari
Aku kata, isteri aku tak sabar
Dia ketawa, dia hulur sebiji mentah
Gigit sikit, Abang, jangan menangis

[Pre-Chorus]
Mata aku kecil, muka aku kerut
Mak Cik tepuk bahu, bagus anak muda

[Chorus]
Jeruk kedondong, masam manis garam
Mak Cik kacau balang, aku pegang lampu
Jeruk kedondong, nanti Subuh siap
Pulanglah dulu, Abang, bawa sebalang

[Bridge - gambus and marwas only]
Pulang bawa balang, isteri dah tidur
Esok pagi dia nak nasi lemak pula

[Outro - gambus, accordion, marwas fade]
Jeruk kedondong, hei, jeruk kedondong
Pukul dua pagi, hei, tak tidur lagi

tracks.title: Loceng Basikal Mak Bidan
tracks.genre: Kristang branyo (Portuguese Settlement Melaka folk dance song)
tracks.subject: an old bidan in the Melaka Portuguese Settlement who cycles to every birth and is paid only in kuih, so her pantry now holds forty-one tins
tracks.caption: Melaka Portuguese-Eurasian branyo folk dance, lively 6/8-feeling two-step. Fiddle playing a bouncing dance melody, acoustic nylon guitar strumming, banjo-like cavaquinho picking offbeats, rebana frame drum with a light shaker, upright bass pulse. Courtyard room sound, live acoustic ensemble. Female alto lead, bright and storytelling, with a mixed group repeating the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, D major. Jolly, boastful, communal mood. No electronic drums, no synthesizers, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar solos, no reggae or ska backbeat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fiddle, cavaquinho, rebana]

[Verse 1]
Ting ting ting, loceng basikal Mak Bidan
Tengah malam gelap, dia kayuh laju
Beg hitam di bakul, tuala di bahu
Anak mana lagi nak keluar malam ni

[Pre-Chorus]
Ibu tarik nafas, ayah gigit kuku
Mak Bidan kata, sabar, saya ada

[Chorus]
Ting ting ting, anak dah sampai
Tangis pertama, kita semua senyum
Bayaran Mak Bidan bukan duit sen
Sebiji kuih, sebiji kuih, penuh tin

[Verse 2]
Empat puluh satu tin dalam almari
Kuih bahulu, kuih tart, kuih kapit
Ada yang keras, ada yang dah lembap
Tapi Mak Bidan makan, dia tak pernah tolak

[Pre-Chorus]
Budak yang dulu dia sambut, dah besar
Sekarang dia menari depan pentas

[Chorus]
Ting ting ting, anak dah sampai
Tangis pertama, kita semua senyum
Bayaran Mak Bidan bukan duit sen
Sebiji kuih, sebiji kuih, buka tin

[Bridge - fiddle and rebana only]
Kayuh lagi, Mak Bidan, jalan masih jauh
Ada rumah lain, lampu dah menyala

[Outro - fiddle, cavaquinho, group clap]
Ting ting ting, loceng basikal Mak Bidan
Ting ting ting, tin baru dah menunggu

tracks.title: Pantun dalam Songkok
tracks.genre: Perak dendang with rebab (slow Malay folk song with rebab, gong and gendang)
tracks.subject: a wife in Kuala Kangsar ironing her husband's songkok before Friday prayers finds a pantun he wrote for her thirty years ago folded in the lining
tracks.caption: Perak Malay dendang, slow traditional folk song with ornamented vocal turns. Rebab bowed lute playing the main melody and long answering phrases, a hand-struck gendang drum with soft rolls, a deep gong marking each phrase end, a seruling bamboo flute for gentle fills. Warm spacious hall acoustic, live recording, natural reverb. Female mezzo lead, unhurried and tender, small traditional ornaments but every word clear. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D minor. Tender, slow, wistful mood. No synthesizers, no drum machine, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no pop beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rebab alone, then gong]

[Verse 1]
Setrika panas atas songkok hitam
Hari Jumaat, azan belum berbunyi
Jari aku rasa kertas dalam kain
Lipat kecil-kecil, dah kuning warnanya

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku buka perlahan, dakwat dah pudar
Tulisan abang juga, kemas dan miring

[Chorus]
Pantun dalam songkok, tiga puluh tahun
Disimpan diam, tak pernah dibaca
Pantun dalam songkok, abang tulis dulu
Untuk aku seorang, baru hari ini sampai

[Verse 2]
Tanam padi di Kuala Kangsar
Kasih abang tak pernah pudar
Walau rambut dah putih berdua
Hati abang masih yang sama

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia keluar bilik, bersiap nak ke masjid
Aku hulur songkok, dia tak tahu apa

[Chorus]
Pantun dalam songkok, aku simpan balik
Tapi pagi ini aku balas dulu
Pantun dalam songkok, aku tulis sebaris
Selit di lipat, esok dia jumpa

[Bridge - rebab and seruling only]
Biar dia cari, biar dia senyum
Songkok yang sama, pantun yang baru

[Outro - rebab, gong, gendang fade]
Songkok hitam, setrika suam
Tiga puluh tahun, masih sama

tracks.title: Cincin di Poket Hujung
tracks.genre: 1990s Malay unplugged acoustic pop-rock (MTV-unplugged style)
tracks.subject: the dawn cleaner of a Klang snooker hall who finds an engagement ring in a corner pocket and puts up a notice, and the woman who comes to claim it asks him to keep it there
tracks.caption: 1990s Malay unplugged acoustic pop-rock, live-room band recording. Steel-string acoustic guitar fingerpicking a rolling pattern, nylon guitar adding a second melody line, soft upright piano chords, brushed snare and kick drum with a light cajon, fretless bass guitar. Live-room unplugged sound with gentle reverb, no studio polish. Male baritone lead, warm and conversational, mid register. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 78 BPM, C major. Reflective, quietly warm, wistful mood. No electronic drums, no synthesizer pads, no autotune, no rap, no heavy distortion, no dance beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft piano]

[Verse 1]
Subuh di Klang, dewan masih gelap
Aku sapu habuk, aku lap kain hijau
Di poket hujung meja nombor lapan
Ada sesuatu berkilat, kecil dan sejuk

[Pre-Chorus]
Sebentuk cincin, tak ada nama
Aku letak atas kaunter, aku tampal kertas

[Chorus]
Cincin di poket hujung, siapa punya
Tiga minggu aku tunggu, tak ada yang datang
Cincin di poket hujung, aku simpan dulu
Kalau dia balik, aku tahu mukanya

[Verse 2]
Petang Khamis, seorang perempuan masuk
Dia baca kertas, dia diam lama
Dia kata, itu bukan hak aku lagi
Cincin tu dari orang yang dah pergi

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia tanya, boleh tak simpan di situ
Biar dalam poket, biar bola lalu atasnya

[Chorus]
Cincin di poket hujung, aku pulang semula
Aku sapu dewan, aku lap kain hijau
Cincin di poket hujung, biar duduk di situ
Sampai ada tangan lain yang berani

[Bridge - guitar and piano only]
Setiap subuh aku jenguk, ia masih ada
Aku tak ambil, aku tak ganggu

[Outro - fingerpicked guitar, piano fade]
Meja nombor lapan, poket hujung
Biar ia tunggu, biar ia tunggu

tracks.title: 十二聲 Tsap-jī siann
tracks.genre: Taigi Piedmont fingerpicked acoustic blues
tracks.subject: A Tamsui church bell-ringer who must pull exactly twelve strokes at noon loses count every day because the florist across the street waves from her window, so the congregation files out for lunch two strokes early.
tracks.caption: Piedmont-style acoustic blues, slow loping 12-bar shuffle in the Taiwanese Hokkien blues tradition. Fingerpicked steel-string guitar with a steady alternating thumb bass, bottleneck slide answering each vocal line, upright bass walking quietly, brushed snare on the backbeat. Dry close-miked room sound with light tape warmth. Male vocal, warm worn mid-low register, relaxed deadpan delivery, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, E major. Wry, lazy, self-teasing mood. No electric distortion, no drum kit crashes, no synth, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
欲十二點矣，我牽起鐘索
欲十二點矣，我牽起鐘索
對面花店彼个小姐，佇窗仔邊招手
我的手一軟，鐘聲就亂去
[Pre-Chorus]
一聲，兩聲，三聲，攏袂歹
第七聲，我的目睭走去伊遐
[Chorus]
噹噹噹，我數袂清
十二聲，拍成十聲
信徒提早出來食中晝
牧師共我講，今仔日鐘較少
[Verse]
昨日伊無佇窗仔邊，我拍十一聲
昨日伊無佇窗仔邊，我拍十一聲
人講鐘仔拍較少，嘛是我的毋著
我坐佇鐘樓，一喙飯食無落
[Pre-Chorus]
一聲，兩聲，三聲，我數甲真
第十聲，我佇看對面的門
[Chorus]
噹噹噹，我數袂清
十二聲，拍成十一聲
信徒坐佇椅仔頂等
牧師共我講，閣少一聲
[Verse]
今仔日伊行過馬路，爬上樓梯
伊講：「先生，你的鐘有夠大聲」
我講：「小姐，我的數學有夠稀微」
伊笑講，明仔載我佇樓跤共你數
[Bridge]
伊佇樓跤數，我佇樓頂拍
一聲一聲，無差半拍
[Chorus]
噹噹噹，這擺我數會清
十二聲，拍十二聲
信徒坐落去，牧師笑出聲
鐘仔嘛咧應，噹噹噹
[Outro]
十二點，十二聲，毋免閣數
伊佇對面，替我數

tracks.genre: Taigi gua-a-tiau (歌仔調) with yueqin
tracks.subject: A village matchmaker tells the groom's family that the girl eats very little and the girl's family that the boy hardly talks, then at the first meeting he talks nonstop and she eats nonstop and they suit perfectly.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese gua-a-tiau opera-folk song, brisk lilting two-beat storytelling tune. Plucked yueqin moon guitar carrying the rhythm, kokiu two-string fiddle doubling the melody with slides, bamboo flute ornaments between lines, wooden clappers and a small gong marking the phrase ends. Dry live stage-room sound. Female vocal, bright forward mid-high register, teasing storyteller delivery, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, D major. Playful, brisk, cheeky mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no rap.

tracks.genre: 1980s Thai hard-rock sing-along with Thai-scale riffs and shouted chorus (big-guitar pub rock)
tracks.subject: Uncle Daeng sits at the same canal bank every Sunday and has hooked only one rubber sandal, which he now brings home and lines up beside the other 'catches' on his shelf
tracks.caption: 1980s Thai hard-rock sing-along with pentatonic Thai-scale guitar riffs. Overdriven electric guitar playing a stomping riff, bass guitar following the root, big open drum kit with plate-reverb snare, Hammond-style organ held under the chorus, gang shouts on the hook. Live-in-the-room 1980s rock mix, warm tape saturation. Male lead vocal, gritty mid-high register, full-chested delivery, melody clearly sung. 132 BPM, E minor. Raucous, good-humoured mood. No rap, no trap drums, no autotune, no synth-pop, no modern compression. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line.

tracks.genre: Thai trip-hop (dusty breakbeat, Rhodes and cello, late-night downtempo)
tracks.subject: Nit, browsing a Chatuchak second-hand stall, pulls a denim jacket off the rack and finds in the pocket a folded note in the handwriting of the best friend she stopped speaking to three years ago
tracks.caption: Thai trip-hop, dusty downtempo with a slow breakbeat. Breakbeat drums with a heavy snare and ghost notes, Rhodes electric piano playing minor seventh chords with tape delay, upright bass holding a deep slow line, solo cello answering the vocal in long bowed phrases. Dark downtempo mix, vinyl crackle, deep dry bass. Male lead vocal, mid register, tired but sung delivery, second-voice harmony on the chorus, melody clearly sung. 82 BPM, B minor. Aching, restless mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no distorted guitars. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and vinyl crackle, breakbeat enters on bar 3]

[Verse 1]
ที่ตลาดนัดจตุจักร เสาร์นี้คนแน่น
ฉันรื้อกองเสื้อ หาตัวที่พอดี
ยีนส์ตัวเก่า ปักชื่อโรงเรียน
ล้วงกระเป๋า เจอกระดาษพับสี่

[Pre-Chorus]
ลายมือกลมกลม ที่ฉันจำได้
เขียนว่าขอโทษ ที่ลืมวันเกิดเธอ

[Chorus]
สามปีที่เราไม่คุยกัน
เธอเก็บมันไว้ในกระเป๋านี้
ฉันยืนอ่านซ้ำ กลางตลาดคนเยอะ
ทำไมไม่เคยส่งมาให้ฉัน

[Verse 2]
เราเคยนั่งหลังห้อง แลกเทปกันฟังทุกวัน
ซื้อซีดีวงโปรด ผลัดกันฝากไว้
แล้ววันหนึ่งทะเลาะ เรื่องเล็กนิดเดียว
ต่างคนต่างเงียบ จนเงียบมานาน

[Pre-Chorus]
ฉันจ่ายสองร้อย ให้แม่ค้ายิ้ม
กอดแจ็กเก็ตไว้ เดินออกจากตลาด

[Chorus]
สามปีที่เราไม่คุยกัน
เธอเก็บมันไว้ในกระเป๋านี้
ฉันพิมพ์ชื่อเธอ ในช่องข้อความ
แล้วเขียนว่า ฉันอ่านแล้วนะ

[Bridge - drums drop out, Rhodes and cello alone]
ถ้าเธอยังเก็บ เบอร์เดิมไว้
ตอบกลับมาหน่อย ก็พอ

[Chorus]
สามปีที่เราไม่คุยกัน
ฉันใส่แจ็กเก็ตตัวนี้แล้ว
ฉันยืนรอที่ป้ายรถเมล์ ถือโทรศัพท์
เธอตอบกลับมาว่า เจอกันนะ

[Outro - cello holds one long note over the fading Rhodes]

tracks.title: Dưới tấm nỉ xanh
tracks.genre: Tây Nguyên cồng chiêng folk-pop with k'ni fiddle
tracks.subject: Anh Khôi, who re-covers the green felt of the pool tables in a Buôn Ma Thuột hall each year, finds something small under the old cloth every time and keeps a box of them for the owner's daughter
tracks.caption: Central Highlands cồng chiêng folk-pop, lively gong-ensemble groove with a bouncing acoustic strum. Three tuned bronze gongs playing an interlocking dancing pattern, a k'ni bowed fiddle carrying the tune with a nasal reedy tone, bright strummed nylon guitar, a small hand drum on the off-beats. Dry wooden room sound, live acoustic mix. Male vocal, warm mid register, bright and clearly sung with a smiling delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, D major. Playful, warm dance mood. No electronic beats, no EDM drops, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gongs, k'ni fiddle]

[Verse 1]
Mỗi năm anh thay tấm nỉ xanh
Ở quán bi-a Buôn Ma Thuột
Kéo lớp nỉ cũ lên nhẹ nhàng
Dưới đó có gì, anh thấy ngay

[Pre-Chorus]
Một đồng xu, một cái kẹp tóc
Một mẩu giấy gấp tư

[Chorus]
Dưới tấm nỉ xanh có chuyện nhỏ
Anh cất vào hộp, không nói ai
Gõ cồng lên, gõ cồng lên nào
Nỉ mới trải ra, chuyện mới nằm đây

[Verse 2]
Năm nay anh thấy một hạt cà phê
Còn nguyên vỏ đỏ, dính cục phấn
Chắc ai làm rơi lúc nói chuyện
Hay ai cố ý để anh tìm

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh đưa cho con gái bà chủ
Cô cười, cô giữ trong tay

[Chorus]
Dưới tấm nỉ xanh có chuyện nhỏ
Anh cất vào hộp, không nói ai
Gõ cồng lên, gõ cồng lên nào
Mai mốt cô mở hộp, cô sẽ hay

[Bridge - gongs only]
Tùng tùng tùng, tiếng cồng đi trước
Anh kéo nỉ thẳng, cô đứng nhìn

[Chorus]
Dưới tấm nỉ xanh có chuyện nhỏ
Giờ anh để lại một mẩu giấy
Gõ cồng lên, gõ cồng lên nào
Cho người thay nỉ năm sau đọc

[Outro - gongs, k'ni fiddle fade]

tracks.title: Bậc đá mòn
tracks.genre: Hát văn ritual chamber folk (đàn nguyệt, phách, trống chầu)
tracks.subject: Bà Tư, a stonemason in the Ninh Vân quarry, recuts the worn steps of a mountain temple and carves one step with a shallow dip where an old woman's walking stick always lands
tracks.caption: Vietnamese hát văn temple-ritual chamber folk, steady processional pulse. Đàn nguyệt moon lute plucked in repeating ornamented phrases, đàn nhị two-string fiddle with a sighing slide, wooden phách clappers keeping the beat, a deep trống chầu drum on the downbeats, a bamboo sáo flute answering. Close wooden temple-room acoustics with gentle reverb. Female vocal, clear mid-high register, ornamented with natural hát văn melismas but every word clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, A minor. Reverent, tender, steady mood. No electronic beats, no EDM, no trance synths, no autotune, no rap, no drum kit.
tracks.lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Bà Tư đục đá dưới chân núi
Từng nhát chắc tay, bụi trắng mờ
Chùa trên cao, ba trăm bậc đá
Mòn lõm giữa lòng, người đi bao đời

[Pre-Chorus]
Bà đo, bà gõ, bà ngẫm
Bậc này ai hay lên nhất

[Chorus]
Đục đi bậc đá, đục đi bậc đá
Chừa một chỗ lõm cho cây gậy
Bà cụ lên chùa mỗi sáng mồng một
Gậy tre gõ đúng chỗ này thôi

[Verse 2]
Cụ già chống gậy, chân run run
Mười năm gõ mãi một chỗ ấy
Đá mới đẹp mà trơn quá
Bà sợ cụ trượt trên bậc phẳng

[Pre-Chorus]
Bà khoét một vết nông nông
Vừa đầu gậy tre của cụ

[Chorus]

Gậy chạm đúng chỗ, cụ cười

[Bridge - sáo, phách]
Không ai biết bà làm gì
Chỉ cây gậy biết, và hòn đá

[Chorus]
Đục đi bậc đá, đục đi bậc đá

tracks.title: Người tượng biết nói
tracks.genre: 2010s Vietnamese indie folk with banjo and harmonica
tracks.subject: A silver-painted street mime on a Hội An bridge who cannot speak while in costume proposes to his girlfriend using only gestures, and she has to guess the question
tracks.caption: 2010s Vietnamese indie folk, easy walking-pace strum. Fingerpicked-then-strummed steel-string acoustic guitar, a bright plucked banjo on the offbeats, a warm harmonica answering the vocal phrases, upright bass walking in two, brushed snare. Warm lo-fi room recording, close mic, slight tape colour. Male vocal, easy mid register, warm and conversational but clearly sung with a gentle smile. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G major. Light, funny, tender mood. No electronic drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no heavy distortion, no stadium choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - harmonica, guitar]

[Verse 1]
Anh đứng trên cầu sơn bạc cả người
Không nhúc nhích, không chớp mắt
Khách bỏ tiền vào cái mũ cũ
Anh chỉ cúi đầu, không nói gì

[Pre-Chorus]
Em đứng ở bên kia đường
Em biết anh đang nghĩ gì

[Chorus]
Anh hỏi bằng tay, em đoán nhé
Một ngón, hai ngón, chỉ vào ngực
Em nói nhà à, em nói đói à
Anh lắc đầu, anh chỉ vào em

[Verse 2]
Anh vẽ cái nhẫn trong không khí
Em tưởng anh đang bắt con ruồi
Anh quỳ xuống một chân trên cầu
Khách chụp ảnh, em đỏ cả mặt

[Pre-Chorus]
Em đoán mãi không ra
Anh thở dài, tượng cũng thở dài

[Chorus]
Anh hỏi bằng tay, em đoán nhé
Một ngón, hai ngón, chỉ vào ngực
Chắc anh đói, muốn ăn cao lầu
Anh gật đầu, rồi lại lắc đầu

[Bridge - harmonica]
Rồi em hiểu, em bật cười
Em đưa tay cho anh đeo vào

[Chorus]
Anh hỏi bằng tay, em đoán rồi
Một ngón, hai ngón, chỉ vào ngực
Em nói có, em nói có mà
Lần đầu tượng bạc nói được một lời

[Outro - harmonica, banjo]

tracks.title: Màu cho em
tracks.genre: 1980s Vietnamese overseas synth-ballad (DX7 pads and drum machine)
tracks.subject: A hand-tinting photo colourist in a Sài Gòn shop who has coloured one woman's black-and-white portrait every week for a year and keeps getting her lipstick colour slightly wrong on purpose, to make her come back and correct him
tracks.caption: 1980s Vietnamese overseas-style synth-ballad, slow and wide. Yamaha DX7 electric piano bell tone playing arpeggios, a warm analog string-synth pad, a LinnDrum-style drum machine with gated-reverb snare, a fretless bass sliding between notes, a clean chorus-drenched electric guitar playing short answering lines. Glossy 1980s studio chorus and plate reverb. Male vocal, smooth mid-low register, sustained notes with a gentle vibrato, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 70 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, wistful, slow mood. No acoustic guitar strum, no modern trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drop, no live drum kit.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - DX7 electric piano, synth pad]

[Verse 1]
Tiệm anh nhỏ ở đường Lê Lợi
Có cọ, có màu, có ánh đèn vàng
Mỗi thứ Bảy em mang tấm ảnh
Hình đen trắng, em cười rất nhẹ

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh pha màu da, màu tóc
Tới đôi môi, tay anh run

[Chorus]
Màu cho em, anh tô sai một chút
Môi hơi đỏ, hay hơi cam quá
Để thứ Bảy sau em quay lại
Cầm cọ chỉ anh màu môi thật

[Verse 2]
Một năm rồi, năm mươi hai tấm ảnh
Mỗi tấm một sắc môi khác nhau
Em nhìn kỹ, em chau mày nhẹ
Rồi em mỉm cười, em không chê

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh biết em biết anh cố ý
Em vẫn đến, anh vẫn sai

[Chorus]
Màu cho em, anh tô sai một chút
Môi hơi hồng, hay hơi tím quá
Để thứ Bảy sau em quay lại
Ngồi cạnh anh dưới ngọn đèn vàng

[Bridge - guitar, pad]
Thứ Bảy này em không mang ảnh
Em mang một hộp son nhỏ

[Chorus]
Màu cho em, giờ anh tô đúng rồi
Môi đúng màu em đang đứng đây
Thứ Bảy sau, và những thứ Bảy nữa
Em vẫn quay lại, anh vẫn tô

[Outro - DX7 electric piano fade]

tracks.title: Chị bán vé đọc kết phim
tracks.genre: Vietnamese Boston-waltz nhạc vàng (3/4 accordion-and-guitar dance song)
tracks.subject: A small-town cinema ticket seller in Cần Thơ who cannot stop telling the queue how each film ends, so the audience now buys tickets just to hear her ending first and then watches the film anyway
tracks.caption: Vietnamese nhạc vàng in a lively Boston waltz, three beats to the bar with a swaying lilt. Accordion carrying the waltz chords and the melody hook, nylon-string guitar plucking the off-beat chords, mandolin tremolo on the fills, upright bass on the first beat, light snare brushes. Warm vintage 1970s Saigon studio sound with light plate reverb. Female vocal, bright mid register, playful and clearly sung with a smile. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, C major. Funny, lively, swaying mood. No electronic beats, no EDM, no autotune, no rap, no synth bass, no heavy distortion.

Chị ngồi quầy vé rạp Hòa Bình

tracks.title: 慢咗三分鐘
tracks.genre: Cantonese 1980s sophisti-pop (Rhodes, fretless bass, light synth)
tracks.subject: A Sheung Wan watch repairer whose regular customer brings in the same watch each month saying it runs three minutes slow; nothing is wrong with it and he keeps pretending to fix it so she keeps coming
tracks.caption: 1980s Cantonese sophisti-pop slow groove. Rhodes piano with soft chords, fretless bass gliding under the beat, warm analog synth pad, gated-reverb drum machine at a relaxed pace, clean chorused electric guitar answering the vocal. Dry 1985 studio gloss. Male mellow mid-register voice, gently sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, E-flat major. Shy, warm, slow-burning mood. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitar, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
上環個舖頭得我一個人
玻璃櫃入面啲錶滴答
每個月頭你都推門入嚟
話隻錶慢咗三分鐘
[Pre-Chorus]
我用放大鏡睇咗又睇
齒輪冇事 係我有事
[Chorus]
慢咗三分鐘 畀我留住你
抹靚個錶面 又話要再睇
你幾時嚟 我都話得閒
慢咗三分鐘 我鍾意咁慢
[Verse]
你坐喺窗邊嗰張矮櫈
睇我撥動粒細螺絲
我話今次可能要成個鐘
其實十秒鐘已經搞掂
[Pre-Chorus]
師傅隻手唔應該震
但係你一望我就震
[Chorus]
慢咗三分鐘 畀我留住你
包好隻錶 又話下個月睇
你幾時嚟 我都話得閒
慢咗三分鐘 我已經撥慢
[Verse]
上個月你冇嚟 我坐到收舖
今朝你推門 帶咗杯熱奶茶
話隻錶行得好準
但係想我睇另一樣嘢
[Bridge]
我隻手停喺齒輪之間
今次唔係隻錶 係我個心
[Chorus]
慢咗三分鐘 我同你直講
唔使再扭錶 我想同你行
你幾時嚟 我都話得閒
而家我哋行得啱啱好
[Outro]
滴答 滴答
三分鐘都唔慢

tracks.title: 十一個聽眾
tracks.genre: Cantonese bangzi-style folk-opera pop (banhu, gongs, wooden clappers)
tracks.subject: A young woman records her podcast inside a wardrobe with towels for soundproofing; she has exactly eleven listeners, all relatives, whom she thanks by name each episode, until episode forty shows a twelfth, a stranger in Canada
tracks.caption: Cantonese folk-opera pop in a lively bangzi style. Banhu playing the bright lead melody with sliding ornaments, wooden clappers driving the beat, small gong and cymbal accents on the turns, yangqin strummed rhythm, upright bass, hand drum. Dry close live-room mix. Female bright theatrical stage voice, sung with firm clear diction. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 116 BPM, D major. Comic, bustling, mock-grand mood. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no distorted guitar.

tracks.genre: Cantonese West Coast cool-jazz saxophone ballad
tracks.subject: Two pen pals matched by a school scheme at twelve finally meet at Hong Kong airport arrivals at fifty, each holding a card written in the other's handwriting
tracks.caption: Cantonese West Coast cool-jazz ballad. Tenor saxophone with soft breathy tone playing the lead lines, brushed snare and ride cymbal, upright bass walking slowly, soft piano comping, muted trumpet in the bridge. Intimate small-club recording with natural room air. Female warm low-mid voice, relaxed and sung with steady pitch. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, B-flat major. Tender, hushed anticipation. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no heavy reverb.

tracks.title: 星期五澆水
tracks.genre: Cantonese ukulele and glockenspiel chamber-folk
tracks.subject: After her desk neighbour resigned, a woman keeps watering the small cactus he left behind every Friday and leaves him progress notes in his old tray, hoping he will come back to collect it
tracks.caption: Cantonese ukulele and glockenspiel chamber-folk. Strummed ukulele with soft downstrokes carrying the rhythm, glockenspiel doubling the melody lightly, upright bass, brushed cajon, soft accordion pad in the bridge. Warm close-mic home-studio sound with small room air. Female light clear voice, gently sung with steady pitch. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, C major. Gentle, wry, hopeful mood. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no heavy bass, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
你辭職嗰日 帶走個紙箱
留低盆仙人球喺我隔籬
你話唔使理 佢冇事嘅
但係我星期五都澆水
[Pre-Chorus]
一湯匙水 唔多唔少
我睇住佢 又高咗少少
[Chorus]
星期五澆水 星期五寫紙條
寫佢今個禮拜點樣
紙條放喺你舊文件盤
你路過就睇到
[Verse]
第一個月 佢冇乜變
第二個月 長咗粒細刺
我寫紙條話 佢冇掛住你
但係我有啲掛住你
[Pre-Chorus]
新同事坐喺你張櫈
問我點解成日同仙人球講嘢
[Chorus]
星期五澆水 星期五寫紙條
寫佢今個禮拜出咗芽
紙條放喺你舊文件盤
三月冇人拎走
[Verse]
今朝返嚟 紙條唔見咗
文件盤入面 有張新嘅
你嘅字 寫住好多謝
仲有下星期五 幾點
[Bridge]
我拆開張紙條 手有啲慌
字好細 但係我睇得清
[Chorus]
星期五澆水 星期五等你
你話你都有睇我寫嘅字
我哋傾咗一個鐘 喺茶水間
仙人球喺度偷聽
[Outro]
星期五 星期五
下個星期五

tracks.genre: Yunnan hulusi and bawu folk-pop
tracks.subject: a young man carries his own three-year-old jar of pickled mustard greens to his girlfriend's flat to cook for her, and the lid will not open for him, her roommate or her brother, until she taps it once with a spoon handle
tracks.caption: Yunnan hulusi and bawu folk-pop, bouncy two-feel groove. Hulusi plays a quick bright melody over drones, bawu answers with breathy low phrases, steel-string acoustic guitar strums light offbeats, upright bass walks in plain quarter notes, shaker and wooden frame drum keep a skipping pulse. Dry close-miked wooden-room production. Male baritone, light and playful, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, D major. Cheeky, warm kitchen mood. No electronic drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no heavy distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - hulusi melody over acoustic guitar strum]

[Verse 1]
我拎著一罈三年的酸菜
一路上抱得比包還要乖
到妳家廚房我說我來
這一鍋湯我已經想很久

[Pre-Chorus]
蓋子轉一轉
咦怎麼不動

[Chorus]
蓋子蓋子轉不開
我手心都紅起來
室友來試了一下
哥哥來試了兩下

[Verse 2]
我用毛巾包著用力扭
我用熱水澆著它的頭
妳在旁邊笑得直不起腰
說三年都等了何必急

[Pre-Chorus]
妳拿起湯匙
輕輕敲一下

[Chorus]
蓋子蓋子轉開了
嘶的一聲全屋都香
我站在原地發呆
妳說原來要這樣敲

[Outro - hulusi and bawu trade a last phrase, guitar fades]

[Intro - nylon-string guitar and a single muted trumpet phrase]

[Verse 1]
舊書店裡我用鉛筆寫價錢

可是有些字我不太想擦

我在櫃台後面

夾著一張電影票根

她說下週一起看

tracks.genre: Mandarin Irish folk session (fiddle and tin whistle)

tracks.title: 送報的檸檬
tracks.genre: guofeng synthwave with guzheng
tracks.subject: a woman who delivers newspapers by bicycle before dawn down one Tainan lane folds each paper differently for a retired teacher, who hangs one lemon on the gatepost every Friday, and she has been counting the lemons
tracks.caption: Guofeng synthwave with guzheng, driving 4/4 outrun pulse. Guzheng plays bright pentatonic arpeggios in sixteenth notes, analog synth bass pulses steady eighth notes, a soft arpeggiated synth shimmers behind the chorus, electronic drum kit with gated snare and four-on-the-floor kick, dizi doubles the hook once. Neon-bright analog gloss, wide stereo. Female voice, clear mid register, smooth and even, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, E minor. Nostalgic, steady, quietly cheerful mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no orchestral strings, no heavy bass drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guzheng arpeggio over analog synth bass]

[Verse 1]
天還沒亮我踩著腳踏車
報紙捆在後座壓著風
巷子第七戶的老先生
每天要摺成不同的樣子

[Pre-Chorus]
星期一船
星期二帽子

[Chorus]
門柱上掛著一顆檸檬
星期五早上黃黃的
我把它放進車籃
我數到今天十九顆

[Verse 2]
他是退休的國文老師
從不開口只在窗後點頭
我不知道他叫什麼名字
只知道他喜歡酸的

[Pre-Chorus]
今天我摺了一朵花
掛在檸檬旁邊

[Chorus]
門柱上掛著一顆檸檬
旁邊多了一張紙條
寫著明天可以進來喝茶
我數到今天二十顆

[Outro - guzheng and dizi, synth pulse fades]

tracks.title: 論文要訂好
tracks.genre: Mandarin stoner rock
tracks.subject: a bookbinder is handed a hundred-page doctoral thesis at midnight that must be bound and on a desk by nine, and he cannot stop reading the dedication page, which names the student's cleaning-lady mother
tracks.caption: Mandarin stoner rock, slow heavy shuffle groove. Fuzz guitar plays a low repeating riff with long sustained chords, bass guitar doubles the riff an octave down, drum kit hits a loose heavy backbeat with ride cymbal, Hammond-style organ holds chords under the chorus. Thick fuzz amp tone, dry garage room, loose and live. Male voice, strong mid-range, gritty but clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 100 BPM, D minor. Frantic, funny, driven mood. No synth lead, no autotune, no rap, no screaming vocals, no electronic drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar riff, bass and drums enter]

[Verse 1]
半夜十二點門被敲開
一個學生抱著一疊紙
他說老闆明早九點
這本論文要交給教授

[Pre-Chorus]
膠鍋燒熱了
針線穿好了

[Chorus]
訂啊訂啊論文要訂好
書背壓緊一點
訂啊訂啊天亮要交
我忘了趕時間

[Verse 2]
致謝那頁寫著一行字
給我媽媽她打掃大樓
我一邊刷膠一邊讀
讀到眼睛有點酸

[Pre-Chorus]
壓書機轉三圈
時鐘走到六點

[Chorus]
訂啊訂啊論文要訂好
訂啊訂啊天亮要交
封面我燙了金字
連媽媽的名字也燙

[Outro - fuzz riff grinds to a held chord]
